context: Use the existing docs.yml release-push deploy. Do not add a second Pages deployer and do not mutate github-pages policy again. After make release-finalize, probe the live custom domain.
description:
REVALIDATED 2026-08-20 against live GitHub/Pages/workflow, not tracker prose.

Customer-visible defect: https://benchbox.dev/results/ returns HTTP 404. The homepage and README still link it. Last github-pages deployment is 2026-07-09 (v0.3.1). docs.yml builds the explorer on develop, then skips deploy because deploy is `push && ref == refs/heads/release` (.github/workflows/docs.yml:298-299). Custom domain benchbox.dev is already verified; github-pages branch policy already permits release (w2 done, verify seq 1 passed 2026-08-13). Live /404.html is also 404, so the SPA fallback is not on the currently deployed site.

Authoritative ship posture: Amendment 2026-08-13 in _project/decisions/single-repo-migration.md and PR #1712 retain results-explorer/, results-data/, and the three publication helpers on release as a Curated Preview. _project/planning/v0.4.0-release-readiness.md still says OUT OF SCOPE (stale 2026-07-31); reconcile that on cut-v0-4-0-release, not by more Pages policy work.

w3 (in_progress) is the remaining engineering action: cut v0.4.0 / push release so the deploy job runs. w4 is live custom-domain acceptance. Do not redo environment policy. Do not block on independent-oracles, D1-D16 closeout, a second GitHub account, or TPC-DS corpus expansion.

anti_patterns.dont: Deploy the curated preview on the current snapshot
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD land the corpus and facet fixes first
anti_patterns.why: the leaderboard renders 15 of 207 rows, 60 results are undisplayable, 142 rows assert validation that 112 bundles never ran, and the SQL/DataFrame facet is empty

anti_patterns.dont: Treat the privacy scrubber or the rollback target as ceremony to be dropped
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD trim only the evidence-transcription requirements, never the safety checks
anti_patterns.why: they exist for real leak and recovery reasons

anti_patterns.dont: block launch on independent-oracles or D1-D16 closeout
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD close this item on live /results/ 200 and range-readable snapshot
anti_patterns.why: those items are post-live certification, not the 404

anti_patterns.dont: change the external environment policy without a fresh read and maintainer change window
anti_patterns.instead: capture current policy, exact requested delta, rollback command, and maintainer authorization at execution time
anti_patterns.why: external settings drift and the mutation affects production publication

anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD push release via the v0.4.0 cut and probe the live URL
anti_patterns.why: w2 already aligned it to release and verify seq 1 passed

anti_patterns.dont: serve direct routes with an e2e-only rewrite and infer GitHub Pages parity
anti_patterns.instead: test the exact site directory and workflow-produced fallback with a static Pages-shaped server
anti_patterns.why: Pages uses the assembled root 404.html artifact

anti_patterns.instead: prove the actual release-push event and environment-protected deploy path
anti_patterns.why: the current workflow can build on dispatch without executing the deployment job

anti_patterns.dont: use can_admins_bypass to make one successful deployment and call the pipeline fixed
anti_patterns.instead: update and verify the github-pages deployment branch policy itself
anti_patterns.why: future automated release pushes would remain ineligible

preserves.behavior: A rollback target, previous deployment ID, deployed commit SHA, workflow run, artifact digest, and custom-domain smoke evidence are captured before declaring success.
Develop remains the authoritative development branch and release remains the curated publication branch.
No deployment begins until the exact corpus being published passes the public path-privacy gate.
Protected branches are never direct-pushed and the github-pages environment is not bypassed as routine deployment machinery.
The launch is labeled curated preview until the cohort/coverage contract permits a broader leaderboard claim.
The root documentation site and existing /docs routes remain byte/functionally intact apart from the deliberate Explorer addition.

prior_art.concept: Extend the existing single Pages build/deploy workflow; do not add a second competing deployer.
Use the existing release-cut curation decision from remediate-explorer-deploy-path-reconciliation rather than bypassing release assembly.
Record the external github-pages environment branch policy beside other repository-admin invariants.
Reuse the direct-route matrix against the exact assembled Pages artifact.
